name: format-google-docs
description: Formato Pro — normalizador de documentos para Google Apps Script

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const os=require('os');const p=require('path');const d=fs.mkdtempSync(p.join(os.tmpdir(),'gas-'));const files=fs.readdirSync('src').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.gs'));if(!files.length){console.error('no .gs files');process.exit(1);}files.forEach((f,i)=>{const dst=p.join(d,'m'+i+'.js');fs.copyFileSync(p.join('src',f),dst);require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',dst],{stdio:'inherit'});});fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('syntax OK ('+files.length+' files)')"
